breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions in the 'Numerical method requirements' section, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' line. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only describes the Strang splitting method, completely omitting the erroneous 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, thus matching the correction made in the ground truth.
